_README: The press pack: who asks the questions at a press conference.
WRITTEN BY HAND, like rules.json and playtest_level.json. export_data.py
EVERY NAME BELOW IS A PLACEHOLDER. They are deliberately called
'Reporter A' and so on, with no outlet and no politics, because the canon
rule is that characters come only from the data files and are never
invented here. Cameron casts them when he is ready.
They ask and they do not fight. A journalist has no intent_pattern, so
nobody takes a turn in a press conference: the questions are the whole of
the opposition. Giving one an intent_pattern here would have them
attacking press tone every turn, which is a different stage from the one
that was asked for - so that is left switched off until Cameron wants it.
